name: Simple Tablet
summary: In the Valley of Trials, a marked parchment sends you to Frang after you prove yourself against local beasts. The warrior trainer waits outside the Den.

sections.title: A Summons to Arms
sections.body: After you prove yourself against the Mottled Boars, Gornek gives you a parchment marked for you alone. Durotar is harsh, so the Horde gives its fighters guidance quickly. The parchment sends you to Frang, the veteran warrior trainer outside the Den.

sections.title: Under the Shade of the Den
sections.body: Frang shelters in the shade outside the Den and watches recruits come from the red scrubland. He judges each arrival with a seasoned eye, then teaches the fundamentals with a heavy axe or a spear. He prepares each recruit to defend the young Horde's fragile settlements.

faq.answer: The Simple Tablet guides young warriors in the Valley of Trials to Frang, the resident warrior trainer.
Frang sends the message. The veteran warrior trainer waits outside the Den for emerging fighters.
Frang waits outside the Den in the Valley of Trials, sheltered from the desert sun beneath rock overhangs.

faq.q: Why does Frang mention spears and axes?
faq.answer: Frang recognizes that Horde recruits fight in different ways. Orcs favor heavy choppers such as greataxes, while trolls and other fighters often choose spears and lighter polearms. Both serve well in battle.

faq.q: Do other classes get this quest?
aliases: class quests in valley of trials
faq.answer: No. Warriors receive the Simple Tablet, while other classes receive no such message and are directed to their own mentors by a parchment, rune, or scroll.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Den?
faq.answer: The Den is a sheltered cavern complex in the Valley of Trials. Trainers, supplies, and resting recruits gather there, away from the blazing heat and wandering beasts.

angles.text: As a warrior, this summons marks your first step on Durotar's warrior path. Frang teaches you foundational stances and strikes.
As a member of the Horde, you join its steady stream of hardened front-line fighters. They are sent to secure Durotar's precarious borders against centaur, quilboar, and human interlopers.
As a Darkspear troll training in the valley, you may hear Frang's gruff observations about your preference for spears over orcish axes. He respects anything that kills.
